done_summary: Implemented constant-time string comparison and jitter for basic auth. Created timingSafeEqual function in src/utils/internal/auth.ts that uses TextEncoder for UTF-8 byte comparison. Modified src/utils/auth.ts to use timingSafeEqual for username and password comparisons, added jitter delays before authentication failures, and improved base64 decoding error handling. The implementation handles passwords with colons correctly by finding the first colon separator.
